name: Permanent Residence -- Standard Route

requirements.blocker_text: Requires lawful residence for at least 2 out of the preceding 3 years, with a minimum of 3 consecutive months of physical presence each qualifying year.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 2 years of lawful residence within a 3-year window, with at least 3 consecutive months present each qualifying year.

evidence_required.document: Police clearance certificates (countries resided in 6+ months over the past decade)

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: minimum 3 consecutive months' physical presence per qualifying year

sources.title: Osher Advisors -- Grenada Permanent Residency: standard route requiring 2 of the preceding 3 years' lawful residence (minimum 3 consecutive months/year), ~US$2,780 government fee, 4-12 month processing, residency card renews every 5 years, revoked after 2+ years' absence or criminal conduct

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Grenada's initial build. STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced only to a tier-3 law firm blog; no official gov.gd or Immigration Department page describing Permanent Residency requirements was located (the Royal Grenada Police Force Immigration Department page returned an error on fetch). revoked_after_absence detail (2+ years) retained in evidence/notes rather than modelled as a separate field. citizenship_after_months (84 = 7 years) mirrors the naturalisation residence figure (see gd_naturalisation.json) as the nearest onward citizenship pathway -- not confirmed that PR time counts directly toward that clock.
